svg.title: writing-prompts · the skill at a glance
svg.text: writing-prompts · the skill at a glance
Writes and revises prompts for another AI. It delivers the prompt and does not carry out the task it describes.
as few as possible, each justified
The ten slots to fill before writing the prompt
what is in, what is out,
Every empty slot becomes a multiple-choice question: the first option is a proposal, the last is «You choose».
The seven files of the skill
Sources: The Prompt Report (Schulhoff et al., arXiv:2406.06608) and Anthropic documentation · License MIT
